Question
========
Choose between two clocks: one is stopped (and predicatably, shows true time twice a day), and the other is always one hour ahead.

Answerlist
----------
* stopped one
* the one that's an hour ahead


Solution
========
As the whole purpose of a clock is to provide information on the passage of time, the clock that is always ahead is still a valuable instrument of time measurement. On the other hand, a stopped clock fails to give any valuable uinformation on the subject, and therefore is useless for its intended purpose.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
